review_text: I recently bought the Safari Thorium Neo 8 Wheels 66 cm medium check-in suitcase and it has exceeded my expectations on every trip! The hard polycarbonate shell feels tough and has protected my luggage well even after multiple journeys — it doesn’t show scratches easily and still looks great. �YouTube +1The 8-wheel 360° spinner system is a big highlight — it glides effortlessly through airports, tight aisles, and hotel lobbies without catching or wobbling. Excellent value for money — definitely recommended! ✈️
